study.question: Does native mean-centered auxiliary product-context transfer require correct example assignment, after controlling its row-gradient distribution and norm? Does the batch-mean component modify this dependence?
study.hypothesis: Observed single-seed full/aligned AUC0.668415616 versus full/swapped0.667910869 suggests example assignment matters. Centered/native0.668362209 retains most of the gain over blocked0.667854872, while mean/native0.667705226 does not; restoring full norm reduced centered AUC to0.668256201 and mean to0.667453176. This does not establish an optimal magnitude or gradient interference mechanism. Hypothesis: the centered term carries useful example-associated supervision; its aligned AUC will exceed its occupancy-closed swap even when the two VJPs have identical row multisets and norm at common weights. Full versus centered assignment gaps distinguish dependence on the batch mean without claiming orthogonality after sparse scatter.

nearest_work.difference: Inherit its entire forward model and native centered VJP. Cross centered/full components with aligned/half_swap assignment; no full-norm restoration.

Receipt and currently supplied candidate.py source (before replacement) expose an occupancy-closed half-swap of full product-context VJPs. Add centered assignment contrast and full replays in the same implementation; do not claim the permutation is new.

inherited_components: All architecture, embeddings, action-aware compressed-history scorer/Dice populations and task towers from history_g3_r0036_centered_native.py
Target-match/order moments, private residual adapters, bounded rank16 product interaction, folded training support and pruned evaluation
True-label four-task BCE and blocked auxiliary item/action/scorer/direct/residual context edges
Occupied-row FP32 native centering; occupancy-closed half-batch assignment from existing full-swap control
study.proposed_difference: A 2x2 backward-only attribution suite. For each auxiliary task incoming context VJP G and occupancy H, full uses G; centered uses C_i=H_i*(G_i-mean_H(G)), FP32 then cast to incoming dtype. Aligned returns this VJP; half_swap permutes rows i and i+B/2 iff both occupied, otherwise fixes them. Swapping occurs after the dtype cast. Thus row multisets, column sums, row-gradient covariance and total L2 are preserved within each component at common weights. No rescaling, labels in forward, new parameters/state/RNG, new prediction features, or altered training exposure. P commutes with C in exact arithmetic; per-ID sparse sums generally change. This is explicitly a surrogate backward intervention, not the derivative of its identity forward or a proposed production objective.
predictions: Predeclared primary contrast D_C = validation click AUC(centered_aligned)-AUC(centered_swapped) is positive; sign is provisional until paired-seed repetition is authorized. No numeric gain is assumed.

Full aligned/swapped reproduce g3-r0034-product_aligned/product_swapped and centered aligned reproduces g3-r0036-centered_native within host determinism tolerance. Replays are integrity controls, not new independent support.

Secondary contrast D_F = AUC(full_aligned)-AUC(full_swapped); interaction I=D_C-D_F. Both positive supports assignment dependence beyond mean effects. A materially different interaction motivates mean/additive/update controls, not a claim that centering is intrinsically better.

At fixed seed/state all four forward probabilities, BCEs, Dice buffers and private task parameter gradients agree; only selected context VJPs change. Aligned/swapped within each component have exactly matching representable row multisets before sparse scatter, including BF16 casting.

Parameters should remain32192421 total/31793216 embeddings/399205 dense; inference paths identical at common weights. Measure training overhead of saved masks/roll versus receipts; no speedup is predicted.
falsifiers: D_C<=0 with matched successful preflight contradicts the predicted assignment benefit at this implementation/seed; do not generalize it to every auxiliary mechanism.
If D_F remains positive but D_C is null/negative, the full-gradient assignment finding does not transfer to the centered-only path; mean interactions or altered optimization remain viable.

A positive single-seed D_C without repetition and authorized clustered uncertainty is preliminary; no reproducible advantage over click-only/blocked after later paired repetitions falsifies useful auxiliary supervision at this setting.

Failed parameter/forward/private-gradient invariance, row permutation norm/distribution invariance, leaked blocked edges or replay integrity invalidates the attribution rather than refuting the scientific mechanism.
alternative_explanations: Single fixed seed; replays verify implementation and are not independent repetitions.
Equal row-edge norms do not imply equal sparse/coalesced embedding gradient norms, clipping, optimizer state or parameter updates.
Half-swap need not be statistically independent of context, repeated user IDs or batch order; ineligible occupied rows remain aligned.
Training trajectories and future private derivatives diverge after the first different shared update; invariance claims are at common weights only.
Centering and swapping can change sparse ID aggregation and Adagrad trajectories without semantic gradient conflict. AUC does not directly measure click/auxiliary gradient alignment.
Repeated validation-directed research entails selection bias. No user-cluster interface or raw user IDs are exposed to this model; do not invent confidence intervals.
Auxiliary labels represent user/category/brand behavior within24h, not ad-specific conversion; official_offline delayed action visibility limits deployment interpretation.
